name: stca
description: Apply original STCA rules to polymer repeat units, fit interpretable rules from measured data, and guide candidate proposals with executable structural checks.

interface.longDescription: Use Weihao Wang's original Sliding Threshold Correlation Analysis for polymer repeat units. Screen candidate structures with frozen published rules; extract readable presence/absence rules from measured datasets and evaluate frozen models; export exact rules for agent-assisted candidate proposal followed by computational verification. Applies the confirmed H-cap representation before RDKit MACCS. Calls the pinned author implementation. Requires a Python/RDKit execution environment and initial access to the source and dependencies. A selected candidate satisfies structural rules; its physical properties still require separate evidence.
defaultPrompt: Screen my polymer SMILES with original STCA low-EC 5% rules, applying H-cap before MACCS.
Extract STCA rules from measured polymer data, freeze the model, and evaluate a held-out dataset.
Propose polymer candidates under STCA constraints, H-cap them, and verify them against the frozen rules.
